semantic_api_boundary.reason: The implementation is a high-level C subsystem, not a CPU ABI emulator.

original_invalid_input_faults.cause: Small-font control handling decrements the byte y from -128 to +127; address mapping chooses 0x8dc4. The second byte at 0x8dc5 overwrites a saved frame pointer before the upper address check. Inputs x=0 and x=1 return normally; x=3 and x=7 reproduce the corrupted return from a freshly reset oracle.
original_invalid_input_faults.observed_native_outcome: Original call does not return to the sentinel; harness observed status 101, pc 0x83700, last instruction 0x3b82.
original_invalid_input_faults.portable_outcome: The same first drawing write is performed in the explicit memory image. C does not have the original CPU call stack and therefore does not reproduce the corrupted return PC.
original_invalid_input_faults.test_handling: Excluded from successful-call framebuffer differential cases; documented here as a deliberate high-level ABI boundary.

original_invalid_input_faults.cause: Wrapped 16-bit lengths access the native call stack. Memmove and memset also keep their loop counts on that stack, so writes can alter the count before corrupting saved return state.
original_invalid_input_faults.observed_native_outcome: 98 clear-row calls and 224 scroll-row calls fail to return; each row, native outcome and framebuffer digest is recorded in analysis/c-verification/render.json. Clear rows 0..32 and 131..255, and scroll rows 0..31, return and match the C memory image outside the native stack.
original_invalid_input_faults.portable_outcome: All byte-valued row arithmetic and signed-overlap copying are translated into bounded explicit memory operations. Native CPU-stack aliasing is not emulated.
original_invalid_input_faults.test_handling: Every byte-valued row is exercised. Successful calls compare all RAM except 0x8d80..0x8dff; faulting calls are separately classified rather than omitted.
